name: Matrix Simulations
summary: Dive beyond the real world into Morpheus’ realm. Inspired by the iconic film series, experience the Matrix Universe right in your room. Given a choice of pills, will you take it? This virtual reality experience is like no other, blending futuristic technology with the nostalgic essence of the original fantasy. Your hands control the action through futuristic phone technology that integrates seamlessly into the virtual environment.
